task_list.notes: Issue: When assigning to a Variable/DataArray (object dtype) via __setitem__ (e.g., .loc indexing), if RHS object has a .values attribute, as_compatible_data coerces to its .values, losing ability to store arbitrary objects. Expected to store the original object (e.g., instances like HasValues). This behavior was introduced by using getattr(data, "values", data) in as_compatible_data. Goal: Prevent coercion for objects with .values unless they are recognized array-like (e.g., pandas/xarray arrays), particularly for object dtype assignments.
